title: Complete Hypercube Subgraphs in Dense Graphs (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.plain: Is there c > 0 such that every graph on 2^n vertices with min degree > (1-c)·2^n contains the hypercube Q_n? Related to extremal graph theory for hypercube embeddings.
whyMatters: Minimum-degree thresholds for spanning hypercubes are a benchmark problem in extremal graph theory.
